description: Committed source of truth for MethylEnricher gene-set library presets. Authored here (config-not-code) and synced into the cfg registry (kind enrichment_library_preset) like the action catalog. Each preset resolves to an ordered, de-duplicated list of Enrichr libraries: default_libraries first (when include_default is true) then the preset-specific libraries.

cancer-core.description: Oncology core: pathways + TF regulators + disease-gene associations.

cancer-extended.description: Oncology core plus drug-target, perturbation, and miRNA target libraries.

neuro-core.description: Neurodegeneration / CNS: pathways + TF regulators + disease-gene associations plus brain/CNS tissue and cell-type gene sets (e.g. Alzheimer detection). Removes oncology-only bias while keeping DisGeNET/GWAS disease priors.

plant-stress-core.description: Plant abiotic stress (e.g. Arabidopsis drought/heat/salt). Drops the human oncology/CNS pathway and disease-prior libraries (include_default is false) and keeps organism-general GO term collections that cover stress-response and hormone-signalling terms. Human-symbol Enrichr libraries do not map to plant AGI locus IDs, so for true Arabidopsis/crop enrichment supply a custom plant GMT via actionConfig.enricher.libraries or run offline ORA; this preset is the discovery default. Use with enricher.organism set to the target species and enrich_disease disabled.
